1. The software this covers

This agreement covers PipelineIQ Books Sync and any other software application we publish that connects to a QuickBooks Online company (the “Software”).

PipelineIQ Books Sync is a private, internal application. It is built and used by RD Graphics for its own bookkeeping. It is not sold, licensed or distributed to the public.

2. What the software does

The Software connects to a QuickBooks Online company through Intuit’s API. It copies invoice and payment records created in our internal job system into that QuickBooks company, so that the accounting records match the work performed and the money received.
